notes: Each of 6 LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, o3-mini, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-3.1-8B) plays independently across 9 belief-pairing conditions x 5 reasoning strategies x 10 simulations; est_calls approximates one cell (10 sims x ~5 turns x 2 roles x 3 seeds) at o3-mini pricing (~$0.05/call ~ $15). Reproducing the full Table 5 grid for o3-mini alone would need roughly 45x more calls (still mid/high tier).
